title: CosmoMail
brief: Write a cold outreach email to a potential partner, Priya Nair (priya@brightlabs.io), introducing our company and proposing a 30-minute intro call next week. Keep it warm, specific, and under 150 words.

initialDraft.subject: Intro from Acme — quick call next week?

assistant.systemPromptExtra: Coach the learner toward a concise, warm, specific outreach email with a single clear ask.
assistant.initialMessage: Want help outlining a warm, specific intro email?

rubricHints.notes: Reward: a clear subject, a warm personalized opener, a specific value proposition, a single explicit ask (30-min call next week), and a professional sign-off. Penalize generic filler and length over ~150 words.
